generation.scope: All windows whose orbit closure contains the primitive rank-twelve quantum boundary are classified by the nullcone on 18 explicit weight lines modulo the diagonal torus and A4. The full marked fiber has 48 maximal supports in four permutation orbits, with unmarked generic dimensions 8,6,6,6 and exact period four there. Torus lattice invariants and the explicit rotation phases decide indexed isomorphism, periods and orbit closure at every support and all special values.
